messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — AcmeCloud (marketplace) just told Sam they’ll require the `X-Client-API` header renamed to `X-Rdwd-Client` for all SDK calls in their marketplace integration. They want a compatibility & comms plan by EOD Friday.

ajay: yikes. do we have a non-breaking alias plan? we can accept both headers server-side for a while.

kevin: We should add a compatibility shim in the runtime for 3 months + a deprecation warning in logs. Proposed behavior: if `X-Rdwd-Client` present, prefer it; if only `X-Client-API` present, accept but emit deprecation telemetry.

sam_partner: Thanks. Also flag: some SI integrators (HardwareCo, EdgeSI) embed the header in device firmware. They need at least 8 weeks of runway before we cut the old header. Can we offer a grace toggle for marketplace partners?

liz: I'll draft a migration snippet for the SDKs and a short note for the marketplace listing. Example snippet to add to SDK changelog: 

```
// v4.2.0 migration
client.setHeader('X-Rdwd-Client', client.getHeader('X-Client-API') || '<default>')
```

ajay: plan suggestion:
- week 0: enable dual-accept in prod + deprecation telemetry (no throttles)
- week 2: send partner comms (marketplace banner + partner emails)
- week 5: start canary where we return `warning` header when old header is used (opt-in list of partners)
- week 8-12: require new header for new marketplace listings; older partners get migration support + feature flag grace for up to 12 weeks

kevin: implementation notes:
- add runtime flag `compat.accept_old_client_header` default true
- emit telemetry event `compat.client_header.used:{old,new}`
- log line when we see old header, but only sample 1% to avoid log noise

ops-bot: deploy job started: `compat-shim:v1` -> canary (3 nodes)

maria: @ajay @kevin @liz @sam_partner this sounds good. Sam — can you confirm AcmeCloud accepts the 12-week grace window? Also ask HardwareCo/EdgeSI for a firmware update ETA. We'll include a marketplace banner and a short FAQ.

sam_partner: pinged AcmeCloud, they said 10 weeks would be OK if we provide a migration test harness and a clear rollback. Asked HardwareCo to confirm by EOD tomorrow.

liz: I'll prep the migration doc + one-page FAQ. Draft will be ready for review by tomorrow AM.

ajay: can someone own the public compatibility matrix? I can wire telemetry to the console once shim is live, but need a central doc we can update per-partner.

maria: I'll create a shared sheet and add partners + planned removal dates. tagging follow-up: @sam_partner to confirm partner ETAs; @kevin to land the runtime toggle today; @liz to publish docs tomorrow.

kevin: starting work now. ETA for shim PR: 6 hours. I'll include unit tests for header precedence and telemetry firing.

ops-bot: deploy success: `compat-shim:v1` -> canary (3 nodes) in 12m

sam_partner: AcmeCloud confirmed 10 weeks and asked for a test endpoint we control so they can run CI against it. I'll coordinate with @kevin for a read-only test route and with @liz for examples.

maria: Great — next sync Friday noon if anything slips. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
